name: Ugreen CM372-80459 38 in 1 clack Aluminum Alloy Screwdriver Set
description:
Aluminum Alloy Handle: L 94 mm
Magnetic Extension Bar: L 60 mm
Screw Bits Dimension: L 28 mm
Screw Bits Dimension 4 x 28 mm
Aluminum alloy handle, magnetic extension bar, 36 screw bits.
Ergonomic handle, rotating cap design, easy and flexible for operations.
The front end of the handle with magnetic design can hold the bits and magnetize the screws.
Chrome vanadium steel forging and heat treatment, the screw bits are durable.
Fully automatic flip cover, you can open and stand this unit on your desk by pressing the button on the box.
Main part is made of CR-V material, with a extendable stick to deal with narrow parts.
Ergonomic magnetic anti skid handle.Rubber coating design, durable and shockproof.
The bits are made of high quality material which have high hardness. Including 36 types of screwdriver bits, can meet different demands.
Press the button, the box cover automatically open and can stand on the table. All tools are well protected by a plastic case, convenient to carry.
Suitable for repairing smart phone and other electronic products.
